rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=6, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=8, n_iter=400, outer_wall_s=1500, lr=0.0003, unet_c=16, rationale=iter-11 ONE-KNOB CEILING-CONFIRMATION PROBE: val_n 4->6 (raise the per-image self-supervised val budget to ALL 6 L277 val scans for a CLEANER ceiling read). Base = the iter-7 WINNING baseline (lr=3e-4, pretrain_epochs=8, n_iter=400, unet_c=16, seed=42, grad_clip=1.0, outer_wall_s=1500); grad_clip RESET 0.5->1.0 (iter-10's tighten was a probe, not a keep) so this isolates val_n alone vs the 0.9562 winner. FAILURE MODE (per-image U-Net N2I converged on Mayo's 2304-view substrate): iters 1-10 exhausted every standard lever -- (a) n_iter 400->800 marginal 0.9501->0.9508 (budget SATURATED, iters 1-2); (b) unet_c 16->32 DEAD on BOTH operating points (iter-3 lr1e-3 0.9508->0.9502; iter-8 anchored 0.9543 < winner); (c) per-scan lr LOCALIZED, 3e-4 bracketed sweet spot (iter-4 0.9541 beats 1e-3@iter-1 0.9501 and 1e-4@iter-5 0.9479 which over-anchors); (d) warm-start pretrain_epochs DIMINISHING (3->6 +0.0017 iter-6, 6->8 +0.0004 iter-7); (e) SEED ceiling-confirmation probe iter-9 (42->1337) landed 0.9549, within ~0.0013 of the 0.9562 winner; (f) GRAD_CLIP ceiling-confirmation probe iter-10 (1.0->0.5) landed 0.9556, within ~0.0006 of the winner -> both CONFIRM the ~0.956 per-image U-Net noise floor and that the iter-6/7/8 spread (0.9543-0.9562) is inside the run-to-run variance band. val_n is the ONE remaining UNTRIED axis at the HIGH end: it has only ever been REDUCED (4 since iter-2, momentarily 3 in iter-8 for wall control), never RAISED for a tighter error bar. HYPOTHESIS (more-scenes-tightens-the-ceiling-estimate, score-inert): the val_score is the MEAN SSIM over the val scans; at val_n=4 it averages only 4 of the 6 L277 central slices, so each reported number carries a wider per-scene sampling error. Raising val_n 4->6 averages over the FULL L277 val set, shrinking the sampling variance and giving the honest ~0.956 ceiling estimate for iters 12-20. EXPECTED OUTCOME: this is a ceiling-DOCUMENTATION probe, NOT a knob expected to climb -- per-image N2I fits each scan independently, so adding 2 more scans changes only WHICH scenes are averaged, not the per-scan converged quality. If the 6-scene mean lands within ~+/-0.001 of 0.9562, it CONFIRMS the ~0.956 ceiling is stable across the full val set (the 4-scene subset was representative) and tightens the error bar. If it swings >0.001, it tells iters 12-20 the 4-scene number was a lucky/unlucky subset and the honest ceiling is the 6-scene mean. Either outcome is a clean, cleaner ceiling read on the val-sampling axis. EXACTLY ONE knob changes (val_n 4->6); lr/pretrain/n_iter/unet_c/seed/grad_clip ALL held at the iter-7 winner. WALL <=15 min: iter-1 (unet_c=16, n_iter=400, val_n=6, pretrain=3) ran ~13.5 min; iter-11 adds +5 warm-start epochs (~290s) over iter-1 but pretrain is amortized once across all 6 scans, and per_scene_s = outer_wall_s/val_n = 1500/6 = 250s HARD-caps each of the 6 per-scene fits so the val loop self-truncates; outer_wall_s=1500 caps the whole loop <=15 min (iter-1's val_n=6 fit it). grad_clip=1.0 mandatory (the 2304-view FBP adjoint overflows otherwise). Converging to the ~0.956 per-image ceiling toward iter-20. DO NOT revert to amortized; per-image N2I rewrite (commit 1f4c3394).
